app.title: Masaar
app.subtitle: Contractor & Tender Management Platform — SCPP Rev 1.0

verdict.title: The ±20% verdict strip — live from the rules engine
verdict.hint: Edit the lowest qualified bid and watch the verdict computed directly by @masaar/scpp-rules.

routing.title: Auto-routing of the eight methods
routing.hint: Enter the estimated value and the engine suggests the contracting method per §11.

gallery.title: @masaar/ui — one system, three skins, two languages
gallery.hint: Every component below reads its result from the rules engine. Switch skin and language and watch the same components re-dress.
gallery.capHint: Drag to simulate the VO value (cap = 10% of contract value)
gallery.railHint: Drag to simulate passing days (14 & 21 WD deadlines)

new.title: New purchase request
new.name: Request name & scope
new.flagRecent: Bidders qualified ≤ 12 months ago, similar scope
new.justificationHint: Mandatory when departing from the engine suggestion
new.splitWarning: Warning: close requests under the same budget code jointly exceed Financial Authority — splitting is prohibited.

ann.preq: All invitees from the pre-qualified list

footer: Phases 3 & 4 — both portals over the rules engine. Remaining: a real API and phase-5 reports per BUILD_PLAN.md

login.title: Sign in to Masaar
login.hint: Role-scoped session — operators see only their own company.
login.ssoNote: Mock — replaced by MSAL once the corporate tenant is available.

admin.title: Admin dashboard
admin.alertsHint: Sorted by severity — accumulated deviation first, then stages past their plan.

mct.title: MCT cycle — tenders above Financial Authority
mct.hint: A live working-day rail from official notification; the prevailing estimate settles automatically per 6.9.
mct.none: No cases above Financial Authority right now

contracts.title: Post-award contract management
contracts.hint: Every cap clause is a live meter: VOs 10%, extension 25%, LDs 10%.

paths.title: The eight-method guide
paths.hint: Pick a method to see its governing condition and stages — on the approved Engineering-Blueprint skin.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: Append-only, no edit or delete (8.1-e) — refused attempts are recorded too.
audit.empty: No entries yet — perform any action in the operator portal.

notices.title: Notifications
notices.stageLate: Tender {{code}}: the current stage is past its planned date.
notices.mctMeeting: Tender {{code}}: {{days}} working days to the MCT meeting deadline (14 WD).
notices.mctAgreement: Tender {{code}}: {{days}} working days to the agreement cap (21 WD).
notices.guarantee: Contract {{code}}: a guarantee expires on {{date}} — renew before lapse.

vendors.title: Vendors & pre-qualification
vendors.hint: Capability registry, MoO list membership, eligibility flags (10.4) and refusal-to-sign bans (14.3).
vendors.name: Vendor

compliance.nomHint: Tier derives from value vs Financial Authority; the deadline runs from the trigger date — a missed deadline lets the LC proceed.
compliance.lcHint: The scope suggested for the five state companies with their response status.

roles.title: The six-role permission matrix
roles.hint: Enforced per endpoint on the server — shown here as the configuration reference.
roles.scopeNote: Operator roles are scoped to their own company; the auditor is read-only post-award (6.7).

reports.title: Reports
reports.hint: Every figure is recomputed from state via the engine — nothing is stored.

review.awardHint: Accredited estimate, lowest qualified bid and the ±20% verdict — all from the engine for the final decision.
review.decisionHint: Ratify the award or return it with notes to the operator. Notes are mandatory on return.
review.notesHint: Reason for return or notes to the operator…
review.notReady: Not yet at the ratification stage
